# awscc_networksecuritymanager_deployment (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::NetworkSecurityManager::Deployment. Creates and manages a Network Security Manager deployment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_name` (String) The name of the deployment.

### Optional

- `associated_policy_list` (Attributes List) List of policies associated with this deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--associated_policy_list))
- `associated_scope_list` (Attributes List) List of scopes associated with this deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--associated_scope_list))
- `deployment_configuration` (Attributes) Configuration settings for the deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment_configuration))
- `deployment_description` (String) A description of the deployment.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags associated with the deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `deployment_arn` (String) The ARN of the deployment.
- `deployment_id` (String) The unique identifier of the deployment.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the deployment.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the deployment was last modified.
- `version` (String) The version number.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networksecuritymanager_deployment.example
  identity = {
    deployment_arn = "deployment_arn"
  }
}
```
